To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The massive unemployment among graduates in China is a result of the expansion of higher education and the mismatch between the graduates’ skills and the requirements of the labour market.

(1) the higher education system has been developed to meet the needs of economic growth; (2) the development of higher education is not in line with the social and economic development of the country; (3) the current policy measures are unable to effectively resolve the problem of graduate employment; and (4) there is an urgent need to restructure the higher education system and the graduate employment policy.
